briefing: Stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 1.6% and the S&P 500 gained 1.3%, a clear risk-on day though short of the +2% level that would justify aggressive buying. The portfolio is up 47.9%, so all 7 existing positions stay in place and their stop-losses and profit targets will handle exits. With the cash we have left, we're making one modest buy of NU, the only candidate where every momentum signal agrees, and skipping overbought names like AXGN and SONO.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and shift money into growth assets like tech stocks, which pushes indexes like the NASDAQ up more than safer parts of the market. That doesn't mean you should buy everything. Even on a good day, the stronger move is to buy only stocks where several signals agree, such as momentum, trend and volume, rather than chasing ones that are already overbought.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心回升，資金流向科技股等增長型資產，令納斯達克等指數升幅跑贏較保守的板塊。不過，市況向好並不代表應該全面入市。即使在升市中，較穩健的做法是只揀選動能、趨勢及成交量多項訊號同時確認的股份，避免追入已經超買的個股。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks rallied across the board today, with tech-heavy NASDAQ (+1.6%) leading the S&P 500 (+1.3%), which suggests investors were willing to take on more risk. Semiconductor and AI hardware names stood out on the screen, including MU, AMD, ENTG, FORM and ARM, and crypto-linked miners such as WULF and MARA also moved higher. No specific news headlines were provided today, so this reading is based only on price and volume data, not on any particular catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股全線造好，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數上揚1.6%，跑贏標普500指數的1.3%，反映市場風險胃納回升。半導體及AI硬件股表現突出，美光（MU）、AMD、ENTG、FORM及ARM等均見技術性轉強，WULF、MARA等加密貨幣礦企亦同步走高。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，以上分析僅根據股價及成交量走勢作出，並未歸因於個別消息。

trades.reasoning: NU is the only candidate showing all four confirmation signals together (MACD bullish crossover with a rising histogram, RSI 62.8 below overbought, price above its 20-day average, and a volume surge), and its low share price lets the remaining ~$446 cash fill one of the 3 open slots.
